hero.badge: A Slow Living Haven on the Hillside
hero.paragraph: Greeda’s Grange is a meticulously restored historic sanctuary cradled in the biodiverse tropical greenery of the Kerala Western Ghats mountains, where every acre is left to coexist with its native flora and fauna. Crafted for dreamers, ramblers, and those seeking to slow their internal watch.

paragraphs: Greeda’s Grange dates back to 1894, originally operating as a hillside spice storehouse. Following three decades of deliberate, warm wooden restoration, it now invites travelers into a state of deep, high-contrast tropical peace in Attappadi, Kerala.

We operate as a genuine eco-sanctuary, coexisting with the native biodiversity around us rather than clearing it, while maintaining every modern comfort (integrated luxury bathrooms, premium heating, and high-speed Starlink routers hidden safely inside restored wooden trunks). Here, you will find quiet river paths, private clear-water natural spring tub baths, and fresh organic tea leaves.

highlights.title: Free-Range Wilderness Walks
highlights.text: Walk freely through 120 acres of native spice gardens, mountain streams, and ancient rosewood trees left wild for local wildlife.

rooms.heading: Curated Spaces for Slow Living
rooms.description: Each cottage structure is crafted from native honeyed limestone, furnished with handmade furniture, and equipped with cozy fireplaces for your peaceful respite.

amenitiesSection.heading: Curated Amenities & Sanctuary Offerings
amenitiesSection.description: From hot bread baskets delivered at sun-up to wild rosemary-infused local cider under starlight, we invite you to live and breathe sensory sanctuary comfort.

locationSection.paragraph: Greeda’s Grange is nestled in the serene tropical heights of Mundanpara, near Agali in Attappadi, Kerala. Tucked away from traffic and city clocks, our peaceful sanctuary is enveloped by misty mountain winds, forest streams, and native spice gardens.
